content.title: Playable now
content.copy:
A universe of creatures is waiting.

Mythical Void is a free browser adventure: hatch a strange creature, explore six living realms and decide what Project Beacon becomes.

No download or account is needed to start. Play now: https://mythicalvoid.com/
content.disclosure: AI-generated marketing illustration inspired by creature profiles from the genetics engine; not gameplay footage.

content.title: Father-and-son beginning
content.audience: Industry, parents, partners and creative-technology peers
content.copy:
Mythical Void began at home with a father, his nine-year-old son and a question: what could generative AI tools and a lot of imagination make possible?

Their conversations became strange creatures, living worlds and a browser game you can play today. Imagination still leads. AI helps the small team explore and build. People remain responsible for the story, safety and important choices.

Play Mythical Void: https://mythicalvoid.com/
content.disclosure: Brand artwork created with generative AI and refined for Mythical Void.

content.title: Creature possibilities
content.copy:
What might hatch from the Void?

Creature genetics mix body shapes, colours, personalities, cosmic affinities and rare mutations. The result is a world of strange possibilities—not a menu of fixed mascots.

Meet the creatures and play free in your browser: https://mythicalvoid.com/
content.disclosure: AI-generated marketing illustration inspired by real genetics-engine profiles; not gameplay footage.

content.title: Restore rather than destroy
content.copy:
The guardians are not the enemy. The Void corruption is.

Learn each encounter, fight beside your creature and clear the pressure holding a guardian. Restoration changes the world and moves the story forward.

Play in your browser: https://mythicalvoid.com/
content.disclosure: Use only build-linked gameplay capture. Do not substitute generated footage.

content.title: NASA-powered discovery
content.copy:
A fictional universe can open a door to real space.

Mythical Void can use NASA's public astronomy, Mars and space-weather data for optional discovery moments. The adventure stays playful; the curiosity can travel much further.

See the game and its family notes: https://mythicalvoid.com/
content.disclosure: Show a real NASA learning moment from a named game build and credit the source data.

content.title: For grown-ups
content.recommendedChannel: Owned website or verified adult-facing channel
content.copy:
Want to see what the child in your life is exploring?

Mythical Void is free to play in a browser. No download, account or payment details are needed to start. The adventure combines exploration, problem-solving, creature care and restoration-focused fantasy battles.

Read the family notes and play: https://mythicalvoid.com/
content.disclosure: Do not describe this as a formal age rating or universal safety guarantee.

content.title: Creator and press introduction
content.audience: Games creators, journalists and newsletter writers
content.copy:
Mythical Void is a playable browser adventure that began as a father-and-son experiment with generative AI and imagination. It combines procedural creature genetics, six restorable realms, story choices and optional NASA-powered discovery.

It is free to try with no download or account required: https://mythicalvoid.com/

If the project fits your audience, we can provide build-linked gameplay footage, artwork disclosures and a concise fact sheet.
